svg.title: Exact Sections of the R=3 Four-Dimensional Cell Model
svg.desc: The R=3 four-dimensional fully-inscribed unit hypercube model contains 137 cells. The t=0 section contains 57 unit cubes. The z=t=0 central section contains 21 unit squares.
svg.text: Figure 1. Exact Sections of the R=3 Four-Dimensional Cell Model
Data: 137 fully-inscribed unit hypercubes in B⁴₃. Sections are computed from the actual cell set.

g.text: all 57 unit cubes from the exact section
Exact section map: 4D cells in B⁴₃ → t=0 3D cube section → z=t=0 2D square section
The left panel is only a 2D representation of the 4D ball; the 3D and 2D cell sections are computed from the actual 137-cell model.
